description: Start leasing a free window or billboard for a brand. The ad (website, name, pitch, logo) is checked first; a refused ad costs nothing. Returns checkoutUrl and leaseId: give checkoutUrl to the person, who pays the monthly price on Stripe within 60 minutes (you can't pay for them, and nothing is charged before they do). No account is needed: the window belongs to the email they pay with. Name, pitch and logo come from the website when left out. Then follow the lease with check_lease. Agents with their own USDC wallet on Base can instead pay for a month themselves with x402 at POST https://thepillar.io/api/v1/leases/x402 (no account; see thepillar.io/developers#x402).

brandName.description: Shown on the window; taken from the website when left out

brandUrl.description: The brand's website (https; a bare domain gets https:// added)

email.description: Prefills Stripe; the window belongs to the email the person pays with

logoUrl.description: A logo or banner image (https); the website's share image is used when left out

pitch.description: One line under the name; taken from the website when left out

windowId.description: Slot id from find_windows, e.g. "F47-S3" or "B-1234"

name: start_lease

checkoutUrl.description: Give this to the person: they pay the monthly price on Stripe

expiresAt.description: The checkout link stops working after this time (60 minutes)

review.description: True when a person reviews the ad after payment, before it goes up

title: Start a lease
